messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Unit Tests Failing?
parts:
I branched from a fresh pull from dev earlier this afternoon, updated some code, and then tried to run unit tests but get a failure with

"src/test/unit/optimization/lbfgs_update_test.cpp: In constructor ‘stan::optimization::mock_lbfgs_update::mock_lbfgs_update(size_t)’:
src/test/unit/optimization/lbfgs_update_test.cpp:58: error: class ‘stan::optimization::mock_lbfgs_update’ does not have any field named ‘LBFGSUpdate’"

Is anyone else seeing this?
